purpose: 숲켓몬 이번 시즌 성장 로드맵 포스터
artPrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a premium, text-free fantasy RPG season ROADMAP POSTER BACKGROUND illustration for the Korean game 숲켓몬. This is the artwork layer only; ALL typography will be professionally typeset afterward with real Korean fonts, so generate ABSOLUTELY NO letters, words, numbers, logos or pseudo-writing.
Portrait 2:3, ideally 2048x3072 native detail, opaque full-bleed.

Core metaphor: steady, loss-free character growth through playing, completing stages, crafting an SSS mercenary from crystal shards, collecting mercenary equipment from legion battles, and earning titles and trophies through effort. A magnificent luminous STAIRCASE is the unmistakable visual centerpiece: substantial black stone steps with narrow warm-gold illuminated edges wind and ascend from the lower center (approximately x=56%,y=79%) toward a radiant elevated destination at upper right (x=84%,y=32%). Clear discrete upward steps, plausible architecture and depth; one continuous path, no impossible Escher loops. A small anonymous fully armored adventurer seen from behind is climbing the right-side stairs, showing scale and earned progress, with a restrained teal cloth cape and a grounded natural pose. No identifiable franchise character, no modern person, no firearm.

Art direction: collector-quality high-end Korean fantasy game key art, beautifully painted realistic stone, ornate gold, deep midnight teal-black sky, subtle emerald and cyan energy, warm platinum/gold highlights. Crisp material detail, cinematic depth and measured bloom. Majestic, hopeful, rewarding, determined. Not cartoon, not a spreadsheet, not dashboard cards, not a UI screenshot, not glossy toy 3D, not rainbow neon, not gaudy flame effects.

Around the RIGHT half of the staircase, integrate three meaningful reward relics into the world, each distinct and easy to recognize: a cluster of luminous cyan crystal shards converging into a majestic dark/gold blank mercenary card frame; an elegant complete set of mercenary armor arranged as a floating chestpiece with gauntlets, with tiny distant legion silhouettes below (no violence); and a beautifully sculpted gold achievement trophy with a laurel crest high on the path. They should be purposeful visual accents along the rising path, not equal-sized icons in boxes. No text on the card or trophy. The trophy is a reward metaphor, not a sports brand. All relics and the small adventurer must stay within the right 50% of the composition. Do not invent extra buildings, creatures, weapons, dates, calendars, coins or currencies.

CRITICAL LAYOUT FOR LATER TYPE:
- Upper 28% of the image must be near-black, spacious, quietly textured negative space, softly lit at most. This is reserved for an enormous Korean title.
- Left 48% from y=34% through y=80% must remain predominantly very dark, calm, and low-detail, with no character, stairs, relic or bright effects crossing it. It will hold four roadmap labels. An understated misty edge can separate it from the right-side illustration naturally.
- Bottom 16% must fade into clean deep midnight-black negative space for a separate next-season teaser.
- Main detailed art is concentrated in x=50%-98%, y=29%-81%. No overly luminous detail at the text margins.
- Keep 5% safe border around all meaningful objects. The steps rise clearly upward toward the gold light at the top-right. The left half still feels like the same environment, not a pasted black rectangle.
Finish: confident art direction, sophisticated silhouettes, cinematic illustrated world with strong spatial depth, disciplined contrast, no border, no watermark.
textWorkflow: ImageGen은 글자 없는 그림만 생성. 브랜드명과 모든 한글은 저장소의 SIL OFL 글꼴로 HTML/CSS 별도 조판.
textPolicy: 날짜·시즌 번호·출시일·확률·보상 수치를 추가하지 않는다. 다음 시즌의 카드·용병 전술과 조합은 별도 예고로 표시.
